title: CROS Constitutional Invariants

statusVocabulary.enforced: Implemented, unit-tested, and invoked on a real execution path.
statusVocabulary.partial: Validator implemented and unit-tested; no production execution path invokes it yet.
statusVocabulary.declared: Specified in prose/JSON only. No implementation.

runtimeStatusNote: No CROS runtime, scheduler, or adapter host exists in this package. Every invariant below is at most 'partial': a validator function that a caller must invoke deliberately.
profileRequiredNote: CI-005 cannot be evaluated without a conformance profile. Replay semantics are profile-specific by construction.

principles.title: Lineage completeness
principles.statement: Every delivered frame traces to a CreativeIntent through an unbroken chain of typed artifacts. No stage may be skipped or synthesised after the fact.

principles.title: Profile-scoped honesty
principles.statement: Reproducibility claims are made in the vocabulary of the active conformance profile. A claim valid under one profile is not portable to another.

principles.title: Adapter subordination
principles.statement: Backends satisfy a contract; they do not extend it. CROS never depends on a specific renderer, model provider, or DCC.

principles.title: Evidence precedes assertion
principles.statement: A render is not complete when pixels exist. It is complete when the evidence package that describes those pixels exists and verifies.

principles.title: Declared is not enforced
principles.statement: Documentation, schemas, and profile JSON are specifications. They are not runtime gates and must never be described as such.

invariants.title: Intent immutability
invariants.statement: An intent artifact is content-addressed. Any change to its body produces a new identity; it never mutates in place.
invariants.rationale: Downstream artifacts cite an intent by hash. In-place mutation would silently invalidate every descendant without breaking any reference.
evidence: src/cros/artifacts.py::canonical_hash — RFC 8785-style canonical JSON over the artifact body with contentHash excluded
invariants.notEnforcedBecause: No persistent artifact store exists. Nothing prevents a caller from editing a dict and recomputing the hash.

invariants.title: Planning derived from valid intent and declared capabilities
invariants.statement: A RenderPlan is a pure function of (a valid RenderIntent, a declared capability set, an active profile). A plan may not introduce requirements absent from the capability set, and must cite the intent hash it was derived from.
invariants.rationale: Plans that exceed declared capabilities fail at execution time, after resources are committed.
evidence: src/cros/planning.py::derive_plan — gen-ai subset only; raises UnsupportedProfileError for cros.dcc-offline
invariants.notEnforcedBecause: Only the gen-ai capability subset has a plan deriver. The dcc-offline planner does not exist.

invariants.title: Execution observability
invariants.statement: A RenderExecution carries at least one progress observation, and observed completion fractions are monotonically non-decreasing.
invariants.rationale: An unobservable long-running render is indistinguishable from a hung one. Monotonicity is what makes progress a signal rather than noise.
invariants.notEnforcedBecause: No adapter host emits progress. streamProgress is a Protocol signature with no implementation.

invariants.title: Evidence before completion
invariants.statement: A RenderResult may not be reported as delivered until a RenderEvidence artifact exists that cites the result hash and carries a content hash for every declared output artifact.
invariants.rationale: Separates 'the renderer exited zero' from 'we can prove what it produced'.
invariants.notEnforcedBecause: No delivery path exists to gate. The validator must be called explicitly.

invariants.title: Profile-scoped replayability
invariants.statement: Every ReplayRecord declares a replayClass, and that class must be permitted by the active conformance profile. No artifact may assert a stronger reproduction class than its profile allows.
invariants.rationale: Bit-identical replay is achievable for a seeded offline path tracer under a locked environment. It is not achievable for a hosted diffusion endpoint. Collapsing both into the word 'reproducible' is the single most common dishonesty in render provenance.

replayClasses.bit-identical: Re-execution yields byte-equal outputs. Requires locked environment, pinned seeds, pinned sample counts, deterministic reduction order.
replayClasses.deterministic-parameters: Re-execution yields equal input parameters and scene state; pixel equality is not asserted.
replayClasses.provider-contract: Re-submission of a recorded request to a pinned provider endpoint. Reproducibility is bounded by the provider's contract. Pixel equality is NOT asserted and MUST NOT be claimed.

invariants.notEnforcedBecause: No replay executor exists. The validator checks the claim, not the reproduction.

invariants.title: Adapter isolation
invariants.statement: An adapter depends only on the CROS contract and its own backend. It may not import a sibling adapter, a host application, or a narrative/authoring layer.
invariants.rationale: Cross-adapter imports turn a swappable backend into a distribution. Host-application imports invert the dependency and make the contract untestable.
invariants.bannedImportNote: 'app' and 'genblaze' name the mrs/apps/genblaze-media host. 'story_forge' is banned by MRS policy: CROS carries no Story Forge lineage. 'cros.adapters' is banned to sibling adapters, not to the contract module.
invariants.status_detail: The import scan is implemented and runs over src/cros in CI. The registry of concrete adapters it would police is empty.
invariants.notEnforcedBecause: No concrete adapter exists yet. The scan currently proves only that the contract package itself is clean.
